summary.text: Kevin Olickal, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 16th House District since January 2023, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly biography describes Olickal as a lifelong resident of Skokie and the son of immigrants.

It says Olickal formerly worked on House Democratic staff, was executive director of the Indo-American Democratic Organization, and was a Cook County COVID-19 recovery specialist for small businesses, and is a part-time law student at Loyola University Chicago School of Law.
